item.content:encoded:
Here are my long-promised comments, sorry for the delay! Wall of text, ahoy!

Doomed:

Such a cool little story. Was kind of struggling to see what in the hell was going on, but it's all sewn up at the end with just a few words. A nice little creepypasta in the semi-surrealistic style, very good!

Daddy:

Oh fuck you. Kids, and dealing with horrors relating to them at night hold a special places of horror in my heart. It was the time when I got up to see to my son in the middle of the night. I clicked on the light…and he was just sitting in his crib, staring. He just stared at me, not moving or doing anything…*brrr*

Delicacy:

Called it somewhat early, but still wonderfully unsettling. I love propping up culture and class with savage, horrible actions.

Demon:

Oh yes, this is…lovely, in a sick way. Moving painting stories are cool as hell when done well, and I'm a bit of a asia geek, so this adds to it. More importantly, it keeps a nice, brisk pace that most painting stories miss, it works perfectly, very good!

Dues:

The best kind of horror: It's only as you walk away, feeling a little confused and unfulfilled, that you suddenly notice the quiet slash that you're now bleeding from. You run off the end of the story like a too-short dock, only to realize that's the point as you fall forward in to disquiet.

Die:

Goddammit, you got me. Didn't even guess at it until the end, damn. Very, very good, should do a whole series of these, really.

Desperation:

YEEK. This one chilled me, pretty bad, actually. Religious drive can be a wonderful thing…or the most frightening thing EVER.

Domain:

Oh hell yes, wow. This is amazing, I really, really like this. A favorite story of mine is “Rawhead Rex”, and this really put me in mind of it…the color changes make it even better, such a simple thing, but it works really well.

Denizen:

EEK. Fucking shit fuck…body horror hits me way, way too hard, and I was really not expecting this. I was pretty sure I figured it out early, and then it right-turned me in to a wall. Very good!

Dark:

Oh lordy yes. This is just wonderful. I'm vain, I'll admit it, and it's always neat to see my creations through someone else's eyes. While the crabby, half-mad Dark from the Game Day series is my current model, I see this as the early, less jaded Dark. When he didn't own every piece on the board, and everything was still a challenge. Another story that took a delightful left-turn on me.

Delight:

A nice, pallet-cleansing story in the midst of horror is always good. I need to read more of these sorts of things, stories that are just there for their own sake. It's nice to come up for air now and then. Then again, it makes the dip back down all the more fresh and raw, but perhaps that's the point.

D-1243:

This works amazingly well right after delight, damn. Here's a nice little sparkling bit of hope for you to hold…and now I'm going to crush it right in your hand. A nice little bleak Foundation tale.

Doll:

AHHHHFUCKINGCREEPYKIDSGODDAMN! Yeesh, man…my daughter has like…fifty stuffed animals on her bed, thanks, now I can never look at them normally again…

Dust You Are:

Actually made my jaw drop. I had no clue at all what the hell was happening. I mean, I thought I had a grasp, but no, I had not the first clue. An amazing look at myth, very, very good!

Thank you so much everyone, honestly, this is amazing, and I am so, so sorry that I took so long to respond. Thank you all so much! And put them in the creepypasta archive, they are too good to bottle up here!
